implementation: Low capability/budget policy preserves available float/RGBA8 baked skinning; explicit unavailable or measured-over-budget recovery caps direct realtime units and uses consumer far billboards.
No instancing caps baked units at 25; no ASTC selects actual PNG. Low normal caps are 50 units and 8 Vfx; fixed budget table unchanged.

SkinnedMeshRenderer-owned MaterialInstances retire after queues drain and before borrowed materials/assets. Original measured realtime leak was 16,800 buffer bytes/cycle; 20 cycles accumulated 336,000 bytes. Final 20-cycle runs have zero growth.

Failed fixture activation cancels partial nodes/assets; required fixture failures close the whole developer stage. AssetLease partial batch failure, late completion and fresh retry preserve other owners.

visualReview.result: Expected 50 or 25 two-bone greyboxes; float and RGBA8 match visually; realtime far scene has 25 checker billboards and no Vfx. Fixed greybox ground remains; no screenshot substitutes for queue/animation assertions.

limitations: Desktop Apple M4 WebGL1 low/PNG uses an owned fresh page that refuses WebGL2 before boot. ASTC is masked in all cases; float/dependent extensions, instancing or vertex sampling are explicitly fault-injected per case. This is not mobile hardware measurement.
Two-bone self-authored greyboxes with default particle systems; sustained 60fps SC4 stage criterion remains open. Raw slow intervals are retained; earlier faster attempts are not substituted.
Measured-budget selection has deterministic regression coverage; this run exercises hardware capability fallback and does not claim measured-budget device evidence.
Raw reports, screenshots and logs remain in ignored .cache; tracked review pins hashes.
